headline: Littler and Greaves drawn together for new 48-player Grand Slam
standfirst: The 20th Grand Slam of Darts has a new format with 48 players in groups of three, and the defending champion faces Beau Greaves in Group A.
body: Defending champion Luke Littler was drawn with Beau Greaves and Niels Zonneveld in Group A for the 2026 Grand Slam of Darts, which runs in Wolverhampton from 14 to 22 November.

This year's event has a new format. To mark the tournament's 20th edition, the field was expanded to 48 players in 16 groups of three, with a stricter route into the knockout stage than the old four-player groups.
Greaves has beaten Littler before, at the World Youth Championship, and Zonneveld beat him at the Belgian Darts Open this year.

Luke Humphries is in Group I with Joe Cullen and Paolo Nebrida. Gerwyn Price meets Sebastian Bialecki and Joe Hunt, and Michael van Gerwen faces Jeffrey de Graaf and Henry Coates. Gian van Veen is in Group M with Bradley Brooks and Carl Sneyd.
Jonny Clayton, who qualified late, was drawn with Rob Cross and Anton Ostlund. Players Championship 31 winner Charlie Manby is in Group F with Ryan Searle and Andrew Gilding.
